description: Decide what an aging open PR should become, then do only that: MODERNIZE (rebase, compare with git range-diff, push with a lease on the old head), REWORK (describe the smallest rewrite, then stop) or CLOSE (cite the evidence and ask a human). Use when asked to rebase, refresh, revive or modernize an old PR, or to judge whether a stale PR still belongs.
name: modernize-pr
title: Modernize PR
